text:
maria: Quick note from onboarding today — two customers hit confusing output: the Python SDK raised a plain RuntimeError when their token expired and a raw 429 in another flow. They saw a stacktrace and opened tickets.

sam: Oof. We should standardize error surfaces across SDKs. Can we agree on typed exceptions and a tiny JSON error body?

jordan: Proposed classes: RedwoodError (base), RedwoodAuthError, RedwoodRateLimitError, RedwoodClientError, RedwoodServerError. Each should expose `code`, `status`, optional `ttl_retry`, optional `user_action`, and `raw_body`.

lee: Suggested server JSON body (example) as a single small payload so SDKs can parse it: `{ "code": "auth.token_expired", "status": 401, "message": "API token expired", "user_action": "reauth", "docs_link": "https://docs.redwood.ai/errors#auth.token_expired" }`

alex: For rate limits: `{ "code": "rate.limit_exceeded", "status": 429, "message": "Rate limit exceeded", "ttl_retry": 12, "user_action": "wait" }` — SDKs should prefer TTL from header if present.

maria: Backwards compatibility: if body absent, SDKs keep current exception types but add the new subclasses where possible (i.e., raise RedwoodAuthError that subclasses existing HTTP/RuntimeError). Also ensure attributes like `status` and `ttl_retry` are accessible.

sam: Sample app handling (py): ```py
try:
    client.generate(...)
except RedwoodRateLimitError as e:
    sleep(e.ttl_retry or 1)
    retry()
except RedwoodAuthError:
    show_login_prompt()
except Exception as e:
    show_friendly("Service temporarily busy — try again")
    if DEBUG: show_raw(e.raw_body or str(e))
```

jordan: Also add sample-app UI default text and an opt-in debug toggle so users don't see raw tracebacks by default. Include copy snippets for support.

lee: CI plan: add tests that mock 401/429 JSON bodies and assert SDK raises typed exceptions and sample-app shows friendly strings. We'll gate SDK PRs on these tests.

alex: Naming nit: prefer `code` and `status` for brevity, and `ttl_retry` to emphasize advisory nature.

maria: Owners: lee (RFC + server body schema), sam (SDK parity tracker), jordan (sample-app + UI copy). We'll add migration notes in changelogs warning that catch-all RuntimeError patterns should switch to the new typed exceptions.

devx-bot: CI: sample-apps/error-handling-tests passed on branch error-contracts (build #1100) :white_check_mark:

maria: Thanks all — I'll follow up with paste-ready support replies and short example screenshots once PRs land.
